reviews.text: We took our 9-year-old to see Jacob for his first barbershop haircut and had a fantastic experience. The shop has a great vibe, and Jacob was wonderful with kids — professional, patient, and clearly skilled at what he does. My son has autism, and Jacob made the whole experience comfortable and easy. It was a complete non-issue. We’re really grateful and will definitely be back. Thank you, Jacob!
reviews.author: Katie Buss

reviews.text:
My son got his haircut this evening, first time in, and honestly we feel so lucky and blessed to have found this place. Great atmosphere, honest and genuine interaction, good conversation, and best of all- amazing talent! Appreciate the cut for my kiddo and will definitely be back! 💕

My son has textured, curly hair and it’s hard to find good barbers in the area— this place is GREAT! Can’t say thank you enough.
reviews.author: Shelby Hebert

reviews.text: Great service from a professional Barbershop. Jake is a true artist of his trade. Impeccable attention to detail and even better customer service. Extremely clean and great environment! #10stars
reviews.author: Timothy Hudson

reviews.text: Wonderful staff and environment. Took both my boys for much needed cuts that both were happy with. Couldn't recommend more!! Thankful to have them in the neighborhood 😃
reviews.author: Mariah “SweetTooth”

reviews.text: This barbershop decided to kick out a person because he was in a wheelchair and did not officially have an appointment. They were rude and did not seem to have any consideration for the fact that he was disabled. They were unable to accommodate his wheelchair and unwilling to work with him in any capacity. I will not be going back to this barbershop again!!!!
reviews.author: casey sullivan
